authoritative_probability_tool.name: BeliefBench raw OpenAI logprob parser
authoritative_probability_tool.distenum_reason: bare-character pilot output was not an eligible structured JSON enum response
authoritative_probability_tool.confirmatory_policy: raw parser authoritative; distenum cross-check required for eligible structured JSON enum responses and may never overwrite raw results

token_event_definition: union of exact one-token code forms differing only by surrounding whitespace
per_response_fields: response_id, returned_model, system_fingerprint, service_tier, provider timestamp, token usage, returned alternative count, parsed alternatives, raw token/logprob/bytes, observed candidate mass, missing candidates
legacy_note: Measurements captured before schema v1 may lack provider top_logprobs_returned; parsed_alternatives is retained and marked as reconstructed, never silently substituted.
